component.name: SidCraft
component.summary: Commodore 64 SID music player and HVSC browser

description.p: SidCraft is an offline desktop player for Commodore 64 SID music files (PSID and RSID). It runs the tune on a cycle-accurate 6502 emulator with the residfp SID model, visualises playback with spectrum, oscilloscope, piano-roll and filter views, and doubles as a browser for the High Voltage SID Collection (HVSC).
